class.name: OcgBndSphere
class.brief_description: This class represents a bounding sphere of a geometric entity (triangle, segment of line or whatever else).
class.description: ! This class represents a bounding sphere of a geometric entity ! (triangle, segment of line or whatever else).

method.name: U
method.description: Returns the U parameter on shape

method.name: V
method.description: Returns the V parameter on shape

method.name: IsValid
method.description: Returns validity status, indicating that this sphere corresponds to a real entity

method.name: Distances
method.description: Calculate and return minimal and maximal distance to sphere. NOTE: This function is tightly optimized; any modifications may affect performance!

method.name: SquareDistances
method.description: Calculate and return minimal and maximal distance to sphere. NOTE: This function is tightly optimized; any modifications may affect performance!

method.name: Project
method.description: Projects a point on entity. Returns true if success
